courses.title: Probability theory

courses.why: Probability is a major field of research and a tool across mathematics, statistics, physics and computer science, and many programs offer it as a qualifying-exam subject.
courses.ready: Proves the limit theorems and martingale results, computes conditional expectations and distributions, and uses simulation to test conjectures.
